2609.19569.title: Large Language Model Agents for Evidence Based Genetic Disease Severity Classification
2609.19569.paper_summary: Disease severity classification for genetic conditions is subjective and labor-intensive, creating bottlenecks in genomic screening, where commercial panels vary widely in size and overlap. We developed an autonomous AI agent integrating Reasoning and Acting (ReAct) with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to classify 10,211 Human Phenotype Ontology terms. It uses American College of Medical Genetics (ACMG)-endorsed severity guidelines and American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG) quality-of-life criteria to retrieve PubMed literature, generate interpretable reasoning chains, and independently verify claims. At the phenotype level, using expert-curated cohorts, the agent achieved 93.55% accuracy (MCC 0.9237) with 82.6% to 91.4% of claims supported by direct evidence or valid inferences. Gene-level severity was aggregated across 8,738 pairs, identifying 3,283 autosomal recessive pairs with severe or profound presentations. External validation showed 95.2% concordance with Mackenzie's Mission gene list. This system enables standardized panel design by providing reliable, automated classification supported by direct evidence.
2609.19569.paper_summary_zh: 疾病嚴重程度的分類對於遺傳條件來說是主觀且勞動密集的，這在基因組篩查中造成了瓶頸，因為商業面板的大小和重疊程度差異很大。我們開發了一個自主的 AI 代理，將推理和行動 (ReAct) 與檢索增強生成 (RAG) 整合，以對 10,211 個人類表型本體術語進行分類。它使用美國醫學遺傳學會 (ACMG) 認可的嚴重程度指導方針和美國婦產科醫學會 (ACOG) 的生活質量標準來檢索 PubMed 文獻，生成可解釋的推理鏈，並獨立驗證主張。在表型層面上，使用專家策劃的隊列，該代理達到了 93.55% 的準確率 (MCC 0.9237)，其中 82.6% 至 91.4% 的主張得到了直接證據或有效推論的支持。基因層面的嚴重程度在 8,738 對中進行了匯總，識別出 3,283 個具有嚴重或深度表現的常染色體隱性對。外部驗證顯示與 Mackenzie's Mission 基因名單的符合率為 95.2%。該系統通過提供可靠的、基於直接證據的自動化分類，實現了標準化面板設計。
